title: O Muslims! Killing is Forbidden in Islam and in Every Religion
body:
(Mawlana stands)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akabar laa ilaaha illa-Lahu, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar wa lillah il-hamd!
We are your servants, O our Lord, and we are giving our most high respects to your most glorified servant
Sayyidina Muhammad (s), alfu salat alfu salaam. And we are asking your forgiveness o our Lord and
protection from sins, and to be under His divinely protection and not to be bad servants but to be good
servants. And we are asking humbly. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajim. Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmani ‘rRaheem. O our Lord!
(Mawlana sits)
O people! Ya ayyuha 'n-naas, as-salamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh. That is title of our
association, association that is just described through holy ones to making ways of servants clear. Therefore,
we are doing this association to show us our direction, if it is true direction or not, as planes using radar. This
is not important, doesn't matter. And you are going to be old man, running water from your eyes, from your
nose? That is normal.
O People! As planes using radars, men must use radar to show them if their direction is true or what is going
to be expected, like a light. Therefore, we are in need of an association that is advising to people and

reminding them or warning them from any danger in front of them. Therefore, we must use that spiritual
radar daily, or another example that time by time I am hearing, is that people are taking their cars to a
garage. For what? They are saying, balance. They are in need, because something wrong they are feeling in
his car and taking to station and asking, “What is wrong? Balance is okay or not?”
Once upon a time, may be fifty years ago, I was going with one of our brothers with his car, before such a time
that everyone’s home had two cars, three cars, five cars. His was one small, old car, and we were going from
Nicosia to Lefke. Because we are going slowly, a big bus was coming and I am saying to my driver, “Oh Yahu,
look coming a big bus. Take it aside.” “O my master I am trying, but my car not listening to me! I am making
like this (Mawlana imitates turning a steering wheel) and it is coming like that (opposite of the way he turned
the wheel). O my shaykh, I must go to look for it a balance.”
O people, we must look time by time if our balance is true or is it in a dangerous position. In this association
everyone must look about their balance, is it right or wrong. That is important, but people never looking for
their balance until they are going to be forced through some illnesses. To go to doctors and ask, “Look at my
balance; what is happening to me?” That is for their physical being, but I am not finding except people asking
for balance for themselves. Their balance is wrong, but never asking for balance for themselves.
“O my friend, your balance is wrong, I am looking.”
“Who are you? You are saying this to me?”
They are never accepting. If you are saying, “You are wrong, no balance,” he may hit you, he may kick you!
Who is saying my balance is untrue?! I know it more than you!
O Mankind, coming in right direction. If you are coming in wrong direction, if hitting his car or his body, he
will then understand, “Too many times my friend is telling me, ‘Look you are in wrong direction,' and I am
not listening, Now I am in hospital, head broken, hands broken, and now I am crying.”
Why you are crying? Because you are not in right balance? Today, I am sorry that influenza making me
sometime now to look my balance, yes sir. Most important thing through the lives of people, to be in safety
here and Hereafter, and to be their balance true. They must hear an association from the authorized one. If a
person is writing, “I am doctor,” and he is not doctor, you going for check up and he giving you wrong

medicine, you shall be more weak and you shall die.
Therefore, association most important balancing for people! Therefore, I was with my Grandshaykh, (Shah
Naqshband, who said), "tariqatuna as-suhbah - Tariqat is association.” Therefore you may look and see if true
or not our souls are in need for balance. And today also, a handful of servants. O my Lord, coming here for
listening something, and to look and to correct their actions, if it is good or bad. That is balance, to know
which acting is true action, which one is not true. True balance gives you benefit and honor here and
Hereafter, a balanced person. Wrong-balanced one may touch him here and Hereafter, something that he is
not going to be happy.
O people, you are given these times for listening. Don’t say, “It is too much to hear that one who is speaking
daily; today we may listen to him. Today we must enjoy our egos to go east and west; no time to listen to him
broadcasting from Lefke!”
You are free, but anything happening to you, you should cry, you should be regretting. And we are saying, O
People! who is listening for a half-hour daily, I think it is giving you a spiritual power, and your spirituality
getting up, and real purpose for spiritual association to make our spirituality more powerful and to reach
more high levels. Because for Man (there are) countless levels, countless levels, and you must try daily at least
one level to be up.
This broadcasting that Shaykh Hisham making for me, I am sorry that is such an old person. People may say,
“He is so old, he doesn't know what he is saying. We must make for enjoyment, leave him to what he is
saying.” But if not, then in one day or one week or one month or one year, someone is coming to you, because
you are not just for this material life and material being. You are at the same time for a spiritual life and
being. You must take care of your spiritual being, because when a time comes, your physical being is not for
you to stand up, and you will say, “O, I neglected, I wasted my whole life with material aspects and never
taking a care for my real being.”
O people, you have a real being! Enough for you to be drunk! You have been granted with your physical
being, a spiritual identity. And you never thinking with your ... going to control heavenly powers. You must
look at your heavenly personality, its identity is looking to heavens. They are going to direct your steps, your
spiritual being and day by day you must try to step even one step up. Therefore, those who are not reaching to

that point, so difficult for them on that day that their physical being finishing and going to be thrown through
graveyard--useless. Like people's cars are now useless, throwing to that place and saying this is a grave for
cars.
You must know that one day you are going to be a useless body and you can't do anything with that, and you
shall be taken by force and thrown into graveyard, cemetery. There is always some signs saying “to cemetery.”
The cemetery is calling. O people, everyone must take a lesson; they must try to take some wisdoms. I am not
a person, I can say something, but the authority of The Master of this world, appointing me to address to
people east to west, north to south.
And I am saying, “O Children of Adam, stop killing each other! It is not the way of Allah to kill each other for
dunya and for Shaytan. Come look after your servanthood!”
O Arabs, Jewish, Turkish, Spanish, Pakistani, Afghanistani, everywhere!!! It is not for them only to kill, burn,
and destroy! It is not for the honor of Mankind!!! (Mawlana is angry)
(Almighty Allah said), “O My angels, on the Day of Resurrection they should be asked, 'O people think on it,
that one day you shall be taken from your graveyard to a plain that should be day of judgment. Heavenly
judgment that for all mankind coming. One minute, coming that for all those people taking weapons and
asking to kill this, to burn that, to destroy that. It is not for your honor.'“
O nations, declaration, every day they must remind them, “O followers of Moses, stop! O followers of Jesus,
stop! O Muslims, followers of Muhammad (s), stop!” (Mawlana stands) O followers, you understand when
you recite Holy Qur'an what you are saying? Yes it is written in Arabic, that the worst thing is fighting, killing
and destroying. Peace is good for you!
(Allah is saying:) “I am that One, giving My last judgment to you on Judgment Day, and I am going to give
My last order or My last decision to people, that ones who are on true ways may go to right, and those who
are not listening to Me and doing so many bad things, never accepting peace, go to the left. And I am taking
revenge that you are killing (My creation). I am asking, 'Am I creating that or are you?' And I am asking, 'O
Mankind, am I ordering you to kill others?' (such things are baatil, false!) And I am ordering to make people
to stand up and to live freely and to do their duties or their missions that they are My servants. I am giving

My last decision, who they are listening I am taking to Paradise side, and those who are not listening, I am
giving My heavenly orders and they are taken to Hell.”
O people, come and listen! I am not asking anything from you; anything you give is nothing. I am asking only
that my Lord accepts me as His weakest servant. That is enough for me to be in enjoyment and in pleasure
and in satisfaction and in endless grants of our Lord!
As-salamu `alaykum! (Mawlana sings)
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Huuuuuuuuu…….
Fatihah (35 minutes)
Before today some people came to me and ask for interview, and I was tired a little bit, and I am thanking to
my Lord that granting to me even a half-hour that my listeners not to go. May they be filled with heavenly
lights, to dress to them dressing the honor of servanthood.
Dome dome dome dome 4x
All praising and all glory
only for our Lord Almighty
Allah Allah, Allah Allah
( 38 minutes)
Whole honor of the Seal of Prophets
that sending through His beloved ones
to a sinner, a sinner servant
to address to you today also
as they like, to be heard
by the servants
of the Lord of Heavens

Dome dome dome dome 4x
Let us to hear, O our Lord,
heavenly singings of angels.
Ooooooh so beautiful, so bright!
So honored, so much glorified!
So much enlightened!
Ooooh angels! angels! angels!
Fatihah
( 45 minutes )
(Shaykh Hisham Effendi and Hajjah Naziha send their salaams. )
Wa `alaykum as-salaam send my salaam to everyone. Wa min Allah at-tawfeeq.
